question: 查询所有北京的用户姓名和邮箱
gold_sql: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE city = '北京' ORDER BY name LIMIT 200;

question: 统计每个城市的客户数量，按人数从高到低排列
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询价格大于1000元的商品名称和价格，按价格降序排列
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 1000 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询过去7天内的订单ID、客户ID、订单日期和状态
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('now', '-7 days') ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询每个商品品类下的商品数量
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询订单金额大于1000元的客户姓名、订单ID和订单金额
gold_sql: SELECT cu.name AS customer_name, o.order_id, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount > 1000 ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 统计每个品类的平均商品价格，只显示均价大于500元的品类
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING AVG(p.price) > 500 ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询销量最高的前5个商品名称和销量
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.status != 'refunded' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_sold DESC, p.name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询平均评分大于等于4分的商品名称和平均评分，按评分降序排列
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询同时购买了手机数码品类和电脑办公品类商品的客户姓名
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.name FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = '手机数码' AND cu.customer_id IN (SELECT cu2.customer_id FROM customers cu2 JOIN orders o2 ON cu2.customer_id = o2.customer_id JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id JOIN categories c2 ON p2.category_id = c2.category_id WHERE c2.name = '电脑办公') LIMIT 200;

question: 列出所有下过订单的客户所在的城市名称（去重），按城市名排序
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.city FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY cu.city LIMIT 200;

question: 查询已发货或已送达的订单ID、客户ID和订单金额，按下单日期降序排列
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status IN ('shipped', 'delivered') ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询价格在500到2000元之间的商品名称和价格，按价格升序排列
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 500 AND 2000 ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 200;

question: 统计状态不是已取消且不是已退款的订单总数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded');

question: 查询购买过手机数码品类商品的客户姓名（去重），按姓名排序
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.name FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = '手机数码' ORDER BY cu.name LIMIT 200;

question: 查询所有商品的名称和价格，并标注价格档次：低于500为低价、500到2000为中价、高于2000为高价，按价格降序排列
gold_sql: SELECT name, price, CASE WHEN price < 500 THEN '低价' WHEN price BETWEEN 500 AND 2000 THEN '中价' ELSE '高价' END AS price_level FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询商品名称、原价和8折优惠后的价格（保留两位小数），按优惠价降序排列
gold_sql: SELECT name, price, ROUND(price * 0.8, 2) AS discounted_price FROM products ORDER BY discounted_price DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 按月份统计2026年的订单数量，按月份升序排列
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200;

question: 统计每个客户的订单数量、消费总额和平均消费金额，按消费总额降序排列
gold_sql: SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spent, COALESCE(AVG(o.total_amount), 0) AS avg_order FROM customers cu LEFT JOIN orders o ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 200;

question: 查询至少写过一条商品评论的客户姓名和邮箱，按姓名排序
gold_sql: SELECT name, email FROM customers cu WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.customer_id = cu.customer_id) ORDER BY name LIMIT 200;
